items.name: Free charm
items.note: The charm unspools. Fire · Mercury → Fireball. The mite is burning matter. You borrowed a key; later you will compose others.
items.look: An orange twist of Free work. It still smells of the recipe it gave you: Fire · Mercury — hunger sent. The mite was burning matter. You borrowed a key; later you will compose others.

items.name: Fire stone
items.note: A stone that remembers hunger. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Warm even at rest. Hunger sleeps in it, waiting to be seated. The Gate of Elements has a socket this size.

items.name: Water stone
items.note: A stone that remembers yield. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: It takes the heat of your hand and keeps none of it. Yield, seated. The Gate of Elements will drink it.

items.name: Earth stone
items.note: A stone that remembers rest. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Heavier than it looks. Rest that will not be hurried. A socket on the Gate of Elements is cut for this weight.

items.name: Air stone
items.note: A stone that remembers breath. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Almost not there. Breath that will not stay, trapped in a body just long enough to be a key.

items.name: Body stone
items.note: Salt, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a standing body.
items.look: Salt, seated. A standing body — the kind that makes a wall stay a wall. The Gate of Aspects wants this.

items.name: Spirit stone
items.note: Mercury, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a thing that goes.
items.look: Mercury, seated. A path opening, a thing that goes. Hold it and you remember that a send is not a wall.

items.name: Mind stone
items.note: Sulphur, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a mind.
items.look: Sulphur, seated. The wildcard that turns a work toward a mind. The Gate of Aspects has a socket that is not for force.

items.name: Grove key
items.note: A key that remembers a vegetable body. A door in the thicket wants it.
items.look: Green-dark, and still a little wet. A standing plant was asked to become a key. The thicket door is cut for this.

items.name: Grove stone
items.note: A stone that remembers a living plant. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Yield and rest given a vegetable body, then marked living. The Gate of Joins will seat it.

items.name: Flood key
items.note: A key that remembers a stood pool. A door in the cistern wants it.
items.look: Cold and sure of its shape. Yield given a body. The cistern door will drink it.

items.name: Flood stone
items.note: A stone that remembers water given a floor. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Water · Salt, seated. A hollow that learned to hold. The Gate of Joins wants this weight.

items.name: Spark key
items.note: A key that remembers hunger given breath. A door in the charge cell wants it.
items.look: It stings the palm. Fire and air already met in it. The charge door is waiting.

items.name: Spark stone
items.note: A stone that remembers a seed of charge. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Hunger given breath, trapped in a body just long enough to be a key. The Gate of Joins has a socket that hums.

items.name: Spare grove key
items.note: An extra key from a path that was not the door. Keep it. A later secret will want extras.
items.look: The same cut as the grove key, but the metal is older. Someone hopped this way before you. A later lock will remember extras.

items.name: Spare flood key
items.note: An extra key from a hop over a door. Keep it for a later secret.
items.look: Brass that still smells of the cistern. The intended door was not the only way. A later secret will want extras.

items.name: Spare spark key
items.note: An extra key from a leap past the charge door. Keep it for a later secret.
items.look: It ticks against the others. Breath and hunger, taken the long way. A later secret will want extras.
